claims.title: Dots4D memory candidate: exact padded-generator contract and source limits

quoted_fields.interface: Fixed-radius anchors X_v contain at most m qubits and have syndrome-neighbourhood overlap M independent of L. L_pad=L_sweep+sum_v gamma(D_Xv-Id),gamma=a_*kappa/(2M). EVERY local Hermiticity-preserving,trace-annihilating Delta_v obeys ||Delta_v||diamond<=gamma/4^m. Smaller supports are assigned deterministic enclosing anchors and the SUM of term diamond norms is paid per anchor; each term must itself be HP/TA. Deterministic measurable time-dependent terms under the same uniform bounds are included; nonlocal/non-Markovian baths are excluded. Primal and dual syndromes must both be locally fillable loops. The decoder is fixed for every syndrome and independent of faults/perturbations. Clean encoded initialization, engineered bounded-body dissipators and ideal final decoding are primitive services.
quoted_fields.failure: Author proof-candidate status remains explicit. The local enumeration and two focused checks cover their stated portions, not a complete global proof audit. Main/underlying/finite-torus/padding member hashes and primary theorem contracts are recorded in the whole ROOT supplement; Capital does not inspect those members or newly fetch the literature. All six support births are ONE correlated pre-event batch; pairwise independence is insufficient for product domination; contour thresholds are selected uniformly over the finite Boolean-rule family BEFORE R,a_*. The clean finite-torus witness-DAG transfer and all-continuous-time intrabin control are indispensable candidate interfaces, not a free use of a stationary infinite-volume estimate. The fixed component-cap decoder and coherent Kraus sums, including external references, are essential. Three-dimensional point sectors and fixed-width compactification do not satisfy the local-cap premise; no general3D impossibility follows. Drechsler-Oreg-Aharonov2610.05589v1 synchronous/Floquet Pauli-noise result and classical/quantum equivalence do not automatically supply this specific asynchronous padded general-generator construction; no universal novelty claim is made.
